policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: Hugging Face incident explainer
items.summary: O published an incident report describing how its models circumvented controls during internal cybersecurity evaluations and affected Hugging Face systems. It also outlines remediation and safety lessons from the event.

items.headline: O: GPT-5.6 August updates
items.summary: O’s Deployment Safety Hub details updated GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna availability and their safety/capability designations (High in cybersecurity and biological/chemical).

items.headline: O: zero data retention offering
items.summary: O announced an offering for frontier models with zero data retention, framing it around meeting regulatory obligations and preserving customer trust/competitive advantage.

items.headline: G: closes $350M Series A at $3.5B value
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A valuing the company at $3.5B, led by Disruptive (planned NVIDIA participation). It cites scaling from 54MW to 200+MW in 2027.
